NOTE: Do NOT manually edit this file. This file is automatically updated when semantic release (release.yml) runs. Manually editing this file can break your releases and break third party tools that use this file.

patches.name: Accent color
patches.description: Swaps Instagram's blue on Follow buttons, links and other highlights for purple, pink, red, orange, green or teal. Restart Instagram to see a change. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Layout.

patches.name: Add to queue
patches.description: Overrides the feed flyout 'Play next in queue' with the TADa video queue.

patches.name: Allow screenshots
patches.description: Lets you take screenshots and record your screen where Instagram normally blocks it, such as disappearing photos and videos in chats. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Messages.

patches.name: Ambient mode
patches.description: Adds options to bypass power saving restrictions for Ambient mode and disable it entirely or in fullscreen.

patches.name: Android Auto
patches.description: Restores YouTube Music playlists and podcasts in Android Auto.

patches.name: App icon
patches.description: Adds an option to select from the Reddit app icons available in the manifest.

patches.name: App refresh rate
patches.description: Adds an option to change the app refresh rate.

patches.name: App refresh rate
patches.description: Adds an option to change the app refresh rate.

patches.name: Ask before a call
patches.description: Asks you to confirm before a call starts from a chat, so a stray tap on the call button doesn't ring anyone, and can take the call buttons off the top of a chat. Both start off. Turn them on in TADa settings > Messages.

patches.name: Ask before a like
patches.description: Asks you to confirm before the Like button under a post likes or unlikes it, so a stray tap doesn't do it for you. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Feed.

patches.name: Ask before a refresh
patches.description: Asks you to confirm before pulling down refreshes Home, Reels or another list, so an accidental pull doesn't replace what you were reading. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Feed.

patches.name: Back leaves Home
patches.description: Makes Back on Home leave Instagram at once, instead of first scrolling the feed to the top and reloading it. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Feed.

patches.name: Blur the bars around Reels
patches.description: Shows a blurred copy of a reel above and below it, or beside it, where Instagram would leave black bars. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Reels.

patches.name: Bypass certificate checks
patches.description: Bypasses certificate checks which prevent YouTube Music from working on Android Auto.

patches.name: Bypass image region restrictions
patches.description: Adds an option to use a different host for user avatar and channel images and can fix missing images that are blocked in some countries.

patches.name: Bypass link redirects
patches.description: Adds an option to bypass redirects and open the original link directly.

patches.name: Captions
patches.description: Adds an option to disable captions from being automatically enabled or to set caption cookies.

patches.name: Change form factor
patches.description: Adds an option to change the UI appearance to a phone, tablet, or automotive device.

patches.name: Change header
patches.description: Adds an option to change the header logo in the top left corner of the app.

options.title: Custom header logo
options.description:
Folder with images to use as a custom header logo.

            The folder must contain one or more of the following folders, depending on the DPI of the device:
            - drawable-hdpi
- drawable-xhdpi
- drawable-xxhdpi
- drawable-xxxhdpi

            Each of the folders must contain the following file(s):
            - tada_header_custom_dark.png

            Required dimensions:
            - drawable-hdpi: 121x36 px
- drawable-xhdpi: 160x48 px
- drawable-xxhdpi: 240x72 px
- drawable-xxxhdpi: 320x96 px

patches.name: Change header
patches.description: Adds an option to change the header logo in the top left corner of the app.

options.title: Custom header logo
options.description:
Folder with images to use as a custom header logo.

            The folder must contain one or more of the following folders, depending on the DPI of the device:
            - drawable-hdpi
- drawable-xhdpi
- drawable-xxhdpi
- drawable-xxxhdpi

            Each of the folders must contain the following file(s):
            - tada_header_custom_light.png
- tada_header_custom_dark.png

            Required dimensions:
            - drawable-hdpi: 194x72 px
- drawable-xhdpi: 258x96 px
- drawable-xxhdpi: 387x144 px
- drawable-xxxhdpi: 512x192 px

patches.name: Change installer source
patches.description: Spoofs the installer source so the app appears to be installed from an app store.

patches.name: Change miniplayer color
patches.description: Adds an option to change the miniplayer background color to match the fullscreen player.

patches.name: Change start page
patches.description: Adds an option to set which page the app opens in instead of the homepage.

patches.name: Change start page
patches.description: Adds an option to set which page the app opens in instead of the homepage.

patches.name: Change the like animation
patches.description: Lets you pick the animation that plays when you double tap a post to like it. The choices are animations Instagram made for its Rings creators. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Reels.

patches.name: Change version code
patches.description: Stops Google Play from offering Meta's updates over your patched Instagram. Going back to the normal Instagram later means uninstalling first, which deletes its data. Later TADa builds need this patch too. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Channel search
patches.description: Adds an option to search inside the channel that is currently open instead of searching all of YouTube.

patches.name: Channel whitelist
patches.description: Adds options to allow whitelisting specific channels to show ads or override playback speeds.

patches.name: Check watch history domain name resolution
patches.description: Checks if the device DNS server is preventing user watch history from being saved.

patches.name: Check watch history domain name resolution
patches.description: Checks if the device DNS server is preventing user watch history from being saved.

patches.name: Clean up Reels
patches.description: Hides extra buttons and prompts on reels, such as Follow, Edits, templates, Meta AI, Ray-Ban Meta glasses, friends' activity, the Add a comment bar, the reply bar on reels from chats, the Save button, the Create and Your algorithm buttons and the Reels tab's top bar. Each one has its own switch, and Burn-in guard can dim a reel's buttons while you aren't touching the screen. Keep clear mode on carries Instagram's clear mode to the next reels. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Reels.

patches.name: Clear the media cache
patches.description: Frees storage by deleting Instagram's saved copies of photos and videos once they pass 500 MB. Your sign-in, drafts and settings stay. A row clears them right away. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Storage.

patches.name: Clone app
patches.description: Changes the app package name to allow installing the same app multiple times. By default ".tada" is appended to the package name. Each cloned install must use a unique package name. Cloning does not work with all apps and using this patch may cause app crashes or other unexpected behavior.

options.title: Package name
options.description: Package name to use for the cloned app.

options.title: Update permissions
options.description: Update custom permissions declared by the app. Fixes installation conflicts, but can break features in certain apps.

options.title: Update providers
options.description: Update provider names declared by the app. Fixes installation conflicts, but can break features in certain apps.

patches.name: Control taps and volume on Reels
patches.description: Lets you choose what a single tap on a reel does: Instagram's default, pause, or mute. Can also keep a reel muted when you press volume up. Both start at Instagram's behavior. Choose them in TADa settings > Playback.

patches.name: Copy comment
patches.description: Adds Copy and Copy username to the menu you get on a comment, so you can copy its text or the commenter's username. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Comments.

patches.name: Copy video link
patches.description: Adds options to display buttons in the video player to copy video links.

patches.name: Crossfade
patches.description: Adds a true dual-player crossfade between consecutive tracks. Requires YouTube Music 9.00 or newer; on older versions the patch is a no-op.

patches.name: Custom branding
patches.description: Adds options to change the app icon and app name. For mounted (root) installations the branding is applied while patching, because it cannot be changed from the app settings.

options.title: App name
options.description: Custom app name.

options.title: Custom icon
options.description:
Folder with images to use as a custom icon.
            
            The folder must contain one or more of the following folders, depending on the DPI of the device:
            - mipmap-mdpi
- mipmap-hdpi
- mipmap-xhdpi
- mipmap-xxhdpi
- mipmap-xxxhdpi
            
            Each of the folders must contain all of the following files:
            tada_adaptive_background_custom.png
tada_adaptive_foreground_custom.png
            
            The image dimensions must be as follows:
            - mipmap-mdpi: 108x108 px
- mipmap-hdpi: 162x162 px
- mipmap-xhdpi: 216x216 px
- mipmap-xxhdpi: 324x324 px
- mipmap-xxxhdpi: 432x432 px

            Optionally, the path contains a 'drawable' folder with a monochrome icon file:
            tada_adaptive_monochrome_custom.xml

            Optionally, the path contains a notification icon in one of the following formats:
            - XML vector drawable placed in 'drawable':
              tada_notification_icon_custom.xml
            - PNG raster images placed in the matching 'drawable-<dpi>' folders:
              - drawable-mdpi/tada_notification_icon_custom.png (24x24 px)
- drawable-hdpi/tada_notification_icon_custom.png (36x36 px)
- drawable-xhdpi/tada_notification_icon_custom.png (48x48 px)
- drawable-xxhdpi/tada_notification_icon_custom.png (72x72 px)
- drawable-xxxhdpi/tada_notification_icon_custom.png (96x96 px)

options.title: App icon
options.description:
The app icon to use, including the notification icon.

            'Automatic' uses the custom icon if one is provided, and otherwise 'Black'.
            Select 'Original' to keep the icon of the unpatched app.

            The icon can be changed later in the app settings, but only for the launcher.
            Android Auto, the app list of the system settings and the apk file always show
            the icon chosen here, and a mounted (root) installation can only change it by
            patching again.

patches.name: Custom branding name for Instagram
patches.description: Changes the Instagram app name to TADa Instagram (or a custom name specified in patch options).

options.title: App name
options.description: The name of the app displayed on launcher and system settings.

patches.name: Custom branding name for Reddit
patches.description: Changes the Reddit app name to the name specified in patch options.

options.title: App name
options.description: The name of the app.

patches.name: Custom font
patches.description: Adds an option to replace Reddit Sans / Roboto with a custom TTF or OTF font file at runtime.

patches.name: Custom player overlay opacity
patches.description: Adds an option to change the opacity of the video player background when player controls are visible.

patches.name: Data saver
patches.description: Saves mobile data by loading smaller photos and starting videos at the lowest quality. It uses Full resolution photos and Default playback quality, so it turns both on. It starts with mobile data only. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Playback.

patches.name: DeArrow
patches.description: Adds options to replace video thumbnails and titles using the DeArrow API, or replace video thumbnails with image captures from the video.

patches.name: Default playback quality
patches.description: Plays videos, reels and video stories at the quality you choose, instead of the one Instagram picks as it plays. Nothing changes until you pick a quality. On by default. Turn it off in TADa settings > Playback.

patches.name: Disable DRC audio
patches.description: Adds an option to disable DRC (Dynamic Range Compression) audio.

patches.name: Disable DRC audio
patches.description: Adds an option to disable DRC (Dynamic Range Compression) audio.

patches.name: Disable Play Store updates
patches.description: Disables Play Store updates by setting the version code to the maximum allowed. This patch may cause unexpected issues with some apps and does not work if the app is installed by root mounting

patches.name: Disable QUIC protocol
patches.description: Adds an option to disable QUIC (Quick UDP Internet Connections) network protocol.

patches.name: Disable QUIC protocol
patches.description: Adds an option to disable QUIC (Quick UDP Internet Connections) network protocol.

patches.name: Disable Shorts resuming on startup
patches.description: Adds an option to disable Shorts from resuming on app startup when Shorts were last being watched.

patches.name: Disable auto feed refresh
patches.description: Adds an option to stop feeds from refreshing automatically after they become outdated.

patches.name: Disable dislike redirection
patches.description: Adds an option to prevent skipping to the next track when the dislike button is pressed.

patches.name: Disable double tap actions
patches.description: Adds an option to disable player double tap gestures.

patches.name: Disable fullscreen gestures
patches.description: Adds options to selectively disable gestures for entering and exiting fullscreen mode, and to disable pinch-to-zoom.

patches.name: Disable haptic feedback
patches.description: Adds an option to disable haptic feedback in the player for various actions.

patches.name: Disable layout updates
patches.description: Adds an option to disable server side layout updates and use an older UI.

patches.name: Disable modern home
patches.description: Adds an option to disable the modern home UI. This patch works with Reddit 2026.24.0 and earlier.

patches.name: Disable player popup panels
patches.description: Adds an option to disable panels (such as live chat) from opening automatically.

patches.name: Disable playlist autoplay
patches.description: Adds an option to stop a playlist from automatically advancing to the next video.

patches.name: Disable rolling number animations
patches.description: Adds an option to disable rolling number animations of video view count, user likes, and upload time.

patches.name: Disable screenshot popup
patches.description: Adds an option to disable the popup that appears when taking a screenshot.

patches.name: Disable scrolling speed limit
patches.description: Adds an option to remove limits of how fast the home and subscription feed can be scrolled.

patches.name: Disable sign in to TV popup
patches.description: Adds options to disable the popups asking to sign into or connect to a TV on the same local network.

patches.name: Disable video codecs
patches.description: Adds options to disable or force HDR, and to disable VP9 codecs.

patches.name: Don't report screenshots
patches.description: Stops Instagram from telling people when you take a screenshot of their disappearing photo or video. Ghost mode, at the top of Ads and privacy, turns it on with the others. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Messages.

patches.name: Don't save recent searches
patches.description: Keeps the accounts and tags you open from search out of your Recent list. Searches already in Recent stay until you clear them. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Explore.

patches.name: Don't send reel watch history
patches.description: Stops Instagram from learning which reels you watched and how far you got. Reels you've already watched may come back. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Reels.

patches.name: Double tap to seek
patches.description: Adds additional double-tap to seek values to the YouTube settings menu.

patches.name: Download any reel
patches.description: Adds Download to the menu of every reel and saves it without Instagram's watermark. You choose the quality, and best is the default. A separate Download cover switch also saves the reel's cover picture, the largest one the post carries, and Download audio saves just its sound. Download as video on a carousel with music saves every page, in order. A separate switch under Downloads puts a download icon under Save beside each reel. On by default. Turn it off in TADa settings > Reels.

patches.name: Download any story
patches.description: Adds Download to the menu of anyone's story. Videos save at the quality you choose and photos at their largest size, and Download as photo saves a still from a video story. On by default. Turn it off in TADa settings > Stories.

patches.name: Download any video
patches.description: Adds Download to video posts in your feed, saving the video without Instagram's watermark. Other switches add Download for photos, Download cover, a Details row with the post's time and poster, a download icon beside Save under each post, and Hold to download, which saves a post or reel you hold two fingers on. Download all waits its turn, with up to ten posts queued, so two posts' pages never mix in your gallery. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Downloads.

patches.name: Download voice messages
patches.description: Adds Save to the menu you get when you hold a voice message in a chat. It saves the recording as an audio file. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Downloads.

patches.name: Downloads
patches.description: Adds support to download songs using the in-app download button, either with an external downloader app or inside YouTube Music.

patches.name: Downloads
patches.description: Adds support to download videos with an external downloader app using the in-app download button or a video player action button.

patches.name: Emoji style
patches.description: Shows every emoji in Google's style instead of your phone's own. The full change shows after you restart Instagram. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Layout.

patches.name: Enable debugging
patches.description: Adds options for debugging and exporting TADa logs to the clipboard.

patches.name: Enable debugging
patches.description: Adds options for debugging and exporting TADa logs to the clipboard.

patches.name: Enable exclusive audio playback
patches.description: Enables the option to play audio without video.

patches.name: Enable forced miniplayer
patches.description: Adds an option to enable forced miniplayer when switching between music videos, podcasts, or songs.

patches.name: Enable swipe to dismiss miniplayer
patches.description: Adds an option to enable dismissing the miniplayer by swiping down on it.

patches.name: Exit fullscreen mode
patches.description: Adds options to automatically exit fullscreen mode when a video reaches the end.

patches.name: Find the reel you came from
patches.description: Open a creator's profile from a reel, then their Reels tab, and it scrolls to that reel and outlines it for a moment. A photo reel is found in their posts. Stop looking ends the search, and Wait for a tap to find it holds it until you tap Find the reel. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Reels.

patches.name: Font
patches.description: Lets you pick the font Instagram's text uses: Instagram's own, your phone's, or a .ttf or .otf file. Restart Instagram to see a change. Starts on Instagram's font. Pick one in TADa settings > Layout.

patches.name: Force fullscreen landscape
patches.description: Adds an option to rotate the player to landscape when entering fullscreen mode on tablets and other large screen devices.

patches.name: Force original audio
patches.description: Adds an option to always use the original audio track.

patches.name: Force original audio
patches.description: Adds an option to always use the original audio track.

patches.name: Force portrait orientation
patches.description: Adds an option to keep the app in portrait orientation when the device is rotated.

patches.name: Force system font
patches.description: Adds an option that renders Reddit with the device system font instead of Reddit Sans / Roboto.

patches.name: Full resolution photos
patches.description: Loads photos in the largest size Instagram sends instead of one picked for your screen. A second switch asks for a larger size on screens under 1440 pixels wide. Uses more data. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Feed.

patches.name: Full screen Reels and Home
patches.description: Hides the status bar and the navigation bar while Reels shows, and optionally while Home does. Swipe in from the edge to bring them back for a moment. Back and the keyboard work as usual. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Reels (Full screen Reels) and Feed (Full screen Home).

patches.name: Fullscreen video scale
patches.description: Adds options to stretch or zoom videos to fill the screen in fullscreen mode.

patches.name: Glass tab bar
patches.description: Draws the tab bar as a floating, rounded pill of frosted glass that blurs what's behind it (Android 12 and newer), with a highlight on the tab you're on. Content can optionally run down behind it. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Tab bar, then restart Instagram.

patches.name: GmsCore support
patches.description: Allows the app to work without root by using a different package name when patched using a GmsCore instead of Google Play Services.

patches.name: GmsCore support
patches.description: Allows the app to work without root by using a different package name when patched using a GmsCore instead of Google Play Services.

patches.name: Group Instagram's notifications
patches.description: Puts Instagram's notifications in one group, or in a group for each type, so they don't fill your notification shade. Tapping one still opens it. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Notifications.

patches.name: Hide AI-labeled reels
patches.description: Leaves out reels that carry Instagram's own AI label. A reel without that label stays. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Reels.

patches.name: Hide Ask button
patches.description: Adds an option to hide Ask button in the search bar.

patches.name: Hide Follow on feed posts
patches.description: Takes the Follow and Subscribe buttons off the top of posts in your feed. The name, time and menu stay. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Feed.

patches.name: Hide Follow on stories
patches.description: Takes the Follow button off the top of stories from accounts you don't follow. The name, time and menu stay. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Stories.

patches.name: Hide Instants
patches.description: Takes the stack of Instants out of your messages. Instants is Instagram's no-edit camera for sharing quick photos with friends. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Messages.

patches.name: Hide Meta AI
patches.description: Removes Meta AI from Instagram's search bars, messages, home top bar, reels menus, share sheet and feed. Each part has its own switch. The search one and the Meta AI posts one start on, the rest start off. Change them in TADa settings > Meta AI.

patches.name: Hide Notes on profile pictures
patches.description: Takes the Notes bubble off profile pictures, yours included. Notes in Messages stay. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Profiles.

patches.name: Hide Reddit search
patches.description: Permanently hides the Reddit search in the contextual menu. This patch does not work with root mounting

patches.name: Hide Reels in the feed
patches.description: Removes the rows of suggested reels from your home feed. A reel posted by someone you follow stays. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Reels.

patches.name: Hide Shorts components
patches.description: Adds options to hide components related to Shorts.

options.title: Hide Shorts app shortcut
options.description: Permanently hides the shortcut to open Shorts when long pressing the app icon in your launcher.

options.title: Hide Shorts widget
options.description: Permanently hides the launcher widget Shorts button.

patches.name: Hide Trending shelves
patches.description: Adds an option to hide the Trending shelves from feed and search suggestions.

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description: Hides sponsored posts, reels and stories, and leaves no gap where an ad would have been. On by default. Turn it off in TADa settings > Ads and privacy.

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description: Adds options to hide fullscreen ads, Premium promotions and video ads.

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description: Adds options to hide ads.

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description: Adds options to hide general ads, Premium promotions and video ads.

patches.name: Hide autoplay preview
patches.description: Adds an option to hide the autoplay preview at the end of videos.

patches.name: Hide buttons
patches.description: Adds options to hide the cast, history, notification, search, voice search, sound search, and Library New buttons.

patches.name: Hide comments
patches.description: Takes the Comment button and the comment count off posts in your feed. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Comments.

patches.name: Hide communities shelf
patches.description: Adds an option to hide the related or suggested communities shelf in subreddits.

patches.name: Hide end screen cards
patches.description: Adds an option to hide suggested video cards at the end of videos.

patches.name: Hide end screen suggested video
patches.description: Adds an option to hide the suggested video at the end of videos.

patches.name: Hide filter bar
patches.description: Adds an option to hide the filter bar at the top of the homepage.

patches.name: Hide flyout menu components
patches.description: Adds options to hide individual items from the player and queue flyout menus.

patches.name: Hide group buttons on the share sheet
patches.description: Takes the New group button and the button that sends to several people as a group off the share sheet, and lets you pick which of the round buttons under the people it shows. You can still start a group from your messages. Both start off. Find them in TADa settings > Sharing.

patches.name: Hide highlights
patches.description: Takes the row of story highlights off profiles, yours and other people's. Bios, counts and posts stay. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Profiles.

patches.name: Hide info cards
patches.description: Adds an option to hide info cards that creators add in the video player.

patches.name: Hide layout components
patches.description: Adds options to hide general layout components.

patches.name: Hide layout components
patches.description: Adds options to hide general layout components.

patches.name: Hide music action buttons
patches.description: Adds options to hide action buttons under the player.

patches.name: Hide navigation buttons
patches.description: Adds options to hide buttons in the navigation bar.

patches.name: Hide paid partnership Reels
patches.description: Leaves out reels with a Paid partnership label, and reels Instagram marks as boosted. Ads have their own switch. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Reels.

patches.name: Hide player flyout menu components
patches.description: Adds options to hide menu components that appear when pressing the gear icon in the video player.

patches.name: Hide player overlay buttons
patches.description: Adds options to hide the player Cast, Autoplay, Captions, Previous & Next buttons, and to hide or change the opacity of the player control buttons background.

patches.name: Hide profile tabs
patches.description: Lets you take the Reels, Reposts and Tagged tabs off profiles, yours and other people's, and keep the grid. Starts with every tab showing. Pick which to hide in TADa settings > Profiles.

patches.name: Hide reels by caption words
patches.description: Leaves out reels whose caption holds a word or phrase from your list, and Home's posts too with Also on Home. Starts off. Turn it on and type the words in TADa settings > Reels.

patches.name: Hide related video overlay
patches.description: Adds an option to hide the related video overlay shown when swiping up in fullscreen.

patches.name: Hide related videos
patches.description: Adds options to hide related videos.

patches.name: Hide sidebar components
patches.description: Adds options to hide the sidebar components.

patches.name: Hide status bar
patches.description: Adds an option to hide the system status bar. Swipe down from the top edge to show it for a moment.

patches.name: Hide suggested accounts in DMs
patches.description: Takes the Accounts to follow section off the bottom of your messages. Your chats and follow requests stay. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Messages.

patches.name: Hide suggested accounts in Reels
patches.description: Leaves out the cards of accounts to follow that Instagram puts between reels. Every reel still plays. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Reels.

patches.name: Hide suggested people on profiles
patches.description: Takes Suggested for you and the Discover people button off profiles. Bios, counts and posts stay. More switches take Suggested for you off the followers and following lists, the Complete your profile cards off your own profile, and People you don't follow back, suggested threads and people, and the Featured section off your notifications. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Profiles.

patches.name: Hide suggested posts
patches.description: Removes posts from accounts you don't follow, suggested accounts, surveys and shopping rows from Home. It also takes shop tiles out of Explore and the shopping bag off posts with tagged products. Posts from accounts you follow stay. Extra switches can also hide the 'Are you interested in this post?' question, all videos, photos, carousels, posts you've liked or posts from accounts you pick. A post's menu has Hide posts from this account to add one to that list, and those posts leave Home on the next refresh. On by default. Turn it off in TADa settings > Feed.

patches.name: Hide suggested stories
patches.description: Removes stories from accounts you don't follow from the row at the top of Home. More switches hide rewinds and memories, or the whole row. Starts on. Turn it off in TADa settings > Stories.

patches.name: Hide that you're typing
patches.description: Stops the people you're chatting with from seeing when you're typing. You still see when they type. Ghost mode, at the top of Ads and privacy, turns it on with the others. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Messages.

patches.name: Hide the Explore grid
patches.description: Empties the grid of posts and reels on the Search tab. Search, recent searches and results stay. A second switch hides the suggested accounts that show when you tap the search bar. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Explore.

patches.name: Hide the Reels tab
patches.description: Takes the Reels tab off the tab bar. Reels in your feed and reels people send you still open. A second switch, Show the Reels tab, puts it back after Home when Instagram built your bar without one, and Hide wins if both are on. Restart Instagram to see the change. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Reels. Under Tab bar, switches do the same for Home, Search, Create and Profile, two put Messages or Activity on the bar when Instagram left them off, switches take the Create and notifications buttons off Home's header, others add a Search, Messages or Ghost mode button to it or put Instagram's logo in its middle, two center the name at the top of profiles and the title on other screens, a list puts the tabs in your order, and another picks the tab Instagram opens on.

patches.name: Hide the Repost button
patches.description: Takes the Repost button and its count off posts and reels, so nothing gets reposted by mistake. Share still works. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Sharing.

patches.name: Hide the Share button
patches.description: Takes the Share button and its count off posts in your feed and off reels. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Sharing.

patches.name: Hide the Threads button
patches.description: Takes the Threads button off the top of profiles, with switches for the Create button and Share profile on your own. The menu and the other buttons stay. Each starts off. Turn them on in TADa settings > Profiles.

patches.name: Hide the comment emoji row
patches.description: Takes the row of quick emoji off above the comment box. The box itself stays. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Comments.

patches.name: Hide the home feed
patches.description: Empties your home feed on purpose, so Home shows only the stories row. Profiles, Explore and Reels still show posts. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Feed.

patches.name: Hide the notes row
patches.description: Takes the row of notes, and the Map bubble in it, off the top of your messages. Your chats stay. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Messages.

patches.name: Hide the search bar in Messages
patches.description: Takes the search bar and its Filter button off the top of your messages, the Meta AI bar too. Your chats and notes stay. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Messages.

patches.name: Hide timestamp
patches.description: Adds an option to hide the timestamp in the bottom left of the video player.

patches.name: Hide video action buttons
patches.description: Adds options to hide video action buttons in fullscreen and portrait modes.

patches.name: Hide your active status
patches.description: Stops people from seeing Active now for you while you use Instagram. You still see when they're active. Ghost mode, at the top of Ads and privacy, turns it on with the others. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Messages.

patches.name: Install next to Instagram
patches.description: Installs this build as a second Instagram beside your normal one, with its own data and sign-in. Pick its package name and app name in the patch's options, and whether its icon gets a TADa badge. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

options.title: Package name
options.description: The second Instagram's package. Each part starts with a letter, with dots between the parts, and it can't be Instagram's own.

options.title: App name
options.description: The name under the second Instagram's icon. It starts with a letter and holds up to 50 characters.

options.title: Mark the icon
options.description: Puts a small TADa badge on the second Instagram's home screen icon, so the two are easy to tell apart. Instagram's other icons you can pick in its settings get it too.

patches.name: Jam queue sharing
patches.description: Shares the host queue and playback controls through an authenticated Jam bridge. Root installation is not supported.

patches.name: Keep Reels auto scroll on
patches.description: Keeps Instagram's auto scroll in Reels turned on after you leave Reels or restart Instagram, until you turn it off yourself. It can also move on to the next reel when one ends on accounts where Instagram doesn't offer auto scroll. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Reels.

patches.name: Keep a seek bar on Reels
patches.description: Keeps a seek bar under every reel, short ones too, with the time played and the reel's length above it, like 0:10 / 0:55. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Reels.

patches.name: Keep in chat
patches.description: Keeps view once and replayable photos and videos in your chats after you open them, so they don't disappear. A photo or video you send stays Instagram's own sent bubble. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Messages.

patches.name: Keep the reel speed
patches.description: Keeps the 2x speed on for the next reels after you lock a reel at 2x (hold its edge, then slide down), until you slide the lock off. On by default. Turn it off in TADa settings > Reels.

patches.name: Lock your messages
patches.description: Covers your inbox and chats, all of Instagram, or just the single chats you pick under Locked chats, until your fingerprint, face or screen lock says it's you. Message notifications only say that a message came. Chats you pick under Hidden chats leave your inbox and their notifications don't post. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Messages.

patches.name: Long press to zoom
patches.description: Press and hold a photo in a feed to see it twice as big around your finger, and let go to close it. Pinch to zoom still works. Keep the zoom open leaves it up after you let go, to drag and pinch from 1x to 4x until a tap or Back closes it. While its switch is on, it takes the place of Instagram's own long press on a photo. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Feed.

patches.name: Loop a story
patches.description: Plays a story again from the start when it ends, instead of moving on to the next one. Tap or swipe to move on. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Stories.

patches.name: Loop video
patches.description: Adds an option to loop videos and display loop video button in the video player.

patches.name: Media notification controls
patches.description: Adds options to disable the seekbar and previous/next buttons in the media notification and headphone controls.

patches.name: Media notification controls
patches.description: Adds options to disable the seekbar and previous/next buttons in the media notification and headphone controls.

patches.name: Message box buttons
patches.description: Lets you take the gallery, sticker and voice message buttons off the message box of a chat, and keep the text box and Send. Starts with every button showing. Pick which to hide in TADa settings > Messages.

patches.name: Miniplayer
patches.description: Adds options to change the in-app minimized player. Patching 21.28.206 and lower has more miniplayer types to choose from.

patches.name: Miniplayer previous and next buttons
patches.description: Adds options to show previous and next track buttons in the miniplayer.

patches.name: Mute button
patches.description: Adds an option to show a player button that mutes the video audio.

patches.name: Navigation bar
patches.description: Adds options to hide navigation bar, labels and buttons.

patches.name: Navigation bar
patches.description: Adds options to hide and change the bottom navigation bar (such as the Shorts button) and the upper navigation toolbar.

options.title: Hide Search app shortcut
options.description: Permanently hides the shortcut to open Search when long pressing the app icon in your launcher.

options.title: Hide Subscriptions app shortcut
options.description: Permanently hides the shortcut to open Subscriptions when long pressing the app icon in your launcher.

patches.name: Network proxy
patches.description: Adds settings to route supported network requests through an HTTP or HTTPS proxy. Including this patch may cause connectivity problems on certain devices

patches.name: Network proxy
patches.description: Adds settings to route supported network requests through an HTTP or HTTPS proxy. Including this patch may cause connectivity problems on certain devices

patches.name: Open Shorts in regular player
patches.description: Adds options to open Shorts in the regular video player.

patches.name: Open channel of live avatar
patches.description: Adds an option to prevent a channel's current live video from opening when tapping its avatar.

patches.name: Open comments without the keyboard
patches.description: Comments open with the keyboard down. A tap in the comment box, or on Reply, still brings it up. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Comments.

patches.name: Open links directly
patches.description: Adds an option to skip over redirection URLs in external links.

patches.name: Open links externally
patches.description: Adds an option to always open links in your browser instead of with the in-app-browser.

patches.name: Open links externally
patches.description: Adds an option to always open links in your browser instead of with the in-app browser.

patches.name: Open links in external browser
patches.description: Opens web links you tap in your usual browser instead of Instagram's built-in one, without Instagram's click tracker. Instagram pages and ads still open in the app. On by default. Turn it off in TADa settings > Ads and privacy.

patches.name: Open system share sheet
patches.description: Adds an option to always open the system share sheet instead of the in-app share sheet.

patches.name: Open videos fullscreen
patches.description: Adds options to automatically open videos in fullscreen portrait or landscape mode.

patches.name: Override YouTube Music buttons
patches.description: Overrides YouTube Music buttons to open any compatible third-party client.

patches.name: Override certificate pinning
patches.description: Overrides certificate pinning, allowing to inspect traffic via a proxy.

patches.name: Picture-in-picture button
patches.description: Adds an option to display a picture-in-picture button in the video player.

patches.name: Play albums songs
patches.description: Adds an option to play the song version of album tracks instead of music videos.

patches.name: Play all
patches.description: Adds an option to play all the videos from a channel and to display play all button in the video player.

patches.name: Playback buffer
patches.description: Adds an option to change the video playback buffer size.

patches.name: Playback in feeds
patches.description: Adds the 'Playback in feeds' setting of YouTube to the TADa settings, where it is always available even if YouTube hides it.

patches.name: Playback speed
patches.description: Adds options to change the playback speed and pitch of tracks.

patches.name: Playback speed
patches.description: Adds options to customize available playback speeds, set a default playback speed, and show a speed dialog button in the video player.

patches.name: Player icon style
patches.description: Adds an option to change the style of the player button icons.

options.title: Custom icons
options.description:
Zip file with icons to use as the 'Custom' icon style.

    Each icon is named after the icon it replaces, such as 'tada_yt_copy.xml'.
    An icon is a vector drawable (.xml), or a white square PNG image (.png, 96x96 pixels is recommended).
    Icons missing from the file keep the 'Automatic' style.

patches.name: PoToken provider
patches.description: Adds option to get PoToken using an external PoToken minter app.

patches.name: PoToken provider
patches.description: Adds option to get PoToken using an external PoToken minter app.

patches.name: Profile posts as a list
patches.description: Opening someone's profile takes you on to their posts as a scrolling list of full posts. Back shows the grid. Your own profile keeps its grid. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Profiles.

patches.name: Pure black dark mode
patches.description: Makes Instagram's dark mode pure black instead of dark gray, on the menus that slide up from the bottom too. It looks deeper and can save battery on an OLED screen. Buttons keep their grays so they stay easy to see. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Read messages without the seen receipt
patches.description: Opening a chat no longer tells people you've seen their messages. You still see when they've seen yours. Mark as read still tells them. Ghost mode turns it on too. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Messages.

patches.name: Reload video
patches.description: Adds an option to display reload video button in the video player.

patches.name: Remember live stream playback position
patches.description: Adds an option to remember the playback position of an ongoing live stream and resume from there when reopening that live stream.

patches.name: Remember repeat state
patches.description: Adds an option to remember the repeat state when playing a new track or playlist.

patches.name: Remember shuffle state
patches.description: Adds an option to remember the shuffle state when playing a new track or playlist.

patches.name: Remove background playback restrictions
patches.description: Removes restrictions on background playback, including playing kids videos in the background.

patches.name: Remove background playback restrictions
patches.description: Removes restrictions on background playback, including playing kids videos in the background.

patches.name: Remove build expired popup
patches.description: Stops Instagram from locking you out with a screen that says this version is too old. A patched build can't update itself, so it would stop working after a few weeks. On by default. Turn it off in TADa settings > Updates.

patches.name: Remove subreddit dialog
patches.description: Adds options to remove the NSFW community warning and notifications suggestion dialogs by dismissing them automatically.

patches.name: Remove the advertising ID
patches.description: Stops Instagram from reading your phone's advertising ID, which ad companies use to follow you between apps. Instagram gets a string of zeros instead. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Remove the empty space at the bottom
patches.description: Takes away the empty gap Instagram leaves under its tab bar for a navigation bar that isn't there. Restart Instagram to see the change. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Layout.

patches.name: Remove viewer discretion dialog
patches.description: Adds an option to remove the dialog that appears when opening a video that has been age-restricted by accepting it automatically. This does not bypass the age restriction.

patches.name: Remove viewer discretion dialog
patches.description: Adds an option to remove the dialog that appears when opening a video that has been age-restricted by accepting it automatically. This does not bypass the age restriction.

patches.name: Restore original titles
patches.description: Adds an option to show the original video titles, video descriptions and channel descriptions instead of the auto-translated ones.

patches.name: Restore trust on re-signed builds
patches.description: Lets Instagram's own checks of who signed the app pass on a patched build, so the parts that need them keep working. Threads, Facebook and Messenger patched with the same key work too. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Resume long videos
patches.description: A video or reel longer than two minutes picks up where you left off the next time you play it on the same account. Live videos and ads start as usual. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Playback.

patches.name: Return YouTube Dislike
patches.description: Adds an option to show the dislike count of tracks with Return YouTube Dislike.

patches.name: Return YouTube Dislike
patches.description: Adds an option to show the dislike count of videos with Return YouTube Dislike.

patches.name: Rounded post corners
patches.description: Rounds the corners of a post's photo, video and carousel pages in Home and Following, at a small or large size. Stories, profiles, Explore and Reels stay as Instagram draws them. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Feed.

patches.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches.description: Removes tracking tags from the links you copy or share, and opens bio links without Instagram's click tracker. The link still opens the same post, reel, story or profile. On by default. Turn it off in TADa settings > Ads and privacy.

patches.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches.description: Removes the tracking query parameters from shared links.

patches.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches.description: Adds an option to sanitize sharing links by removing tracking query parameters.

patches.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches.description: Removes the tracking query parameters from shared links.

patches.name: Save comment photo
patches.description: Adds Save to the menu on a comment that has its own photo or GIF, saving the largest size Instagram sent. A GIF is saved as a .gif in Pictures/Instagram, taken from Instagram's own copy, not Giphy. If Instagram lists only an animated WebP or an MP4 for it, you get that file instead, and an MP4 goes in Movies/Instagram like a video. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Comments.

patches.name: Save profile picture
patches.description: Adds Save profile picture, View profile picture, Copy username and Copy bio to the menu on someone's profile. View opens the picture full screen and lets you zoom. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Downloads.

patches.name: Save to Watch later
patches.description: Adds an option to display save to Watch later button in the video player.

patches.name: Saved on your profile
patches.description: Adds a bookmark to the tabs on your own profile, beside posts, reels and tagged, that opens Saved. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Profiles, then restart Instagram.

patches.name: Scrobbling
patches.description: Adds options to add played tracks to Last.fm and ListenBrainz.

patches.name: See who a story mentions
patches.description: Adds a small label in a story's header showing how many accounts it mentions. Tap it for a list and tap an account to open their profile. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Stories.

patches.name: Seekbar
patches.description: Adds options to show old seekbar thumbnails, disable precise seeking when swiping up on the seekbar, slide to seek instead of playing at 2x speed when pressing and holding, tapping the player seekbar to seek, hiding the video player seekbar, enabling seeking in live streams, and expanding the live stream DVR duration.

patches.name: Settings menu filter
patches.description: Adds an option to hide items on the standard YouTube Music settings screen by their visible name.

patches.name: Settings menu filter
patches.description: Adds an option to hide items on the standard YouTube settings screen by their visible name.

patches.name: Shorts autoplay
patches.description: Adds options to automatically play the next Short.

patches.name: Shorts icon style
patches.description: Adds an option to change the style of the Shorts action button icons.

options.title: Custom icons
options.description:
Zip file with icons to use as the 'Custom' icon style.

    Each icon is named after the icon it replaces, such as 'tada_shorts_heart.xml'.
    An icon is a vector drawable (.xml), or a white square PNG image (.png, 96x96 pixels is recommended).
    Icons missing from the file keep the 'Automatic' style.

patches.name: Show a post's exact time
patches.description: Shows the date and time a post went up, like Oct 2, 3:45 PM, instead of how long ago. It does the same for comments. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Feed.

patches.name: Show a reel's exact time
patches.description: Adds the date and time a reel was posted under the author's name, like Oct 2, 3:45 PM, with the seconds or how long ago (1d 2h 5m ago) if you want them. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Reels.

patches.name: Show a story's exact time
patches.description: Shows the date and time a story was posted, like Oct 2, 3:45 PM, instead of how long ago. A choice under the switch can show the time left instead. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Stories.

patches.name: Show all recent searches
patches.description: Lists every recent search under the search bar instead of the first few. See all and the x on each row work as before. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Explore.

patches.name: Show hidden like counts
patches.description: Shows how many likes a post or reel has when its owner hid the count, as long as Instagram's server still sends the number. If it doesn't, nothing changes. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Feed.

patches.name: Show if a profile follows you
patches.description: Adds Follows you or Doesn't follow you beside the name on someone's profile. Other switches add a chip and mark accounts on your Following list that don't follow you back, and Recent unfollowers shows who left your Followers list. The chip is blue for Follows you, green for Following each other and red for Doesn't follow you, and it can go small under the profile picture. On by default. Turn it off in TADa settings > Profiles.

patches.name: Show view count
patches.description: Adds an option to show the view count of Posts.

patches.name: Show when someone was last active
patches.description: Shows the exact time someone was last on, like Active at 3:42 PM, in your messages and in a chat, instead of Active 3h ago. Active now stays. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Messages.

patches.name: Skip silence
patches.description: Adds an option to automatically skip silent pauses in audio playback.

patches.name: Skip silence
patches.description: Adds an option to automatically skip silent pauses in audio playback.

patches.name: SponsorBlock
patches.description: Adds options to enable and configure SponsorBlock, which can skip non-music segments.

patches.name: SponsorBlock
patches.description: Adds options to enable and configure SponsorBlock, which can skip undesired video segments such as sponsored content.

patches.name: Spoof app version
patches.description: Adds an option to trick the app into thinking you are running an older version.

patches.name: Spoof app version
patches.description: Adds an option to trick the app into thinking you are running an older version.

patches.name: Spoof device dimensions
patches.description: Adds an option to spoof the device dimensions which can unlock higher video qualities.

patches.name: Spoof location
patches.description: Tells Instagram your phone is at a place you pick, for the location sticker, nearby places and maps. Photos keep their own places. You need to pick a place too. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Ads and privacy.

patches.name: Spoof signature
patches.description: Spoofs the package signature of the original APK.

patches.name: Spoof signature
patches.description: Spoofs the signature of the app to fix notification issues.

patches.name: Spoof video streams
patches.description: Adds options to spoof the client video streams to fix playback.

patches.name: Spoof video streams
patches.description: Adds options to spoof the client video streams to fix playback.

patches.name: Start Home on Following
patches.description: Opens Home on posts from accounts you follow instead of For you. A second switch removes For you from Home, and a third keeps Instagram's logo at the top of Home in place of the feed's name. Restart Instagram to see the change. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Feed.

patches.name: Start as guest
patches.description: Skips the forced startup login screen using Reddit's native guest browsing mode.

patches.name: Start feed videos with sound
patches.description: Starts the first video on Home with its sound on, the same as tapping the video's speaker. Your phone's ringer and volume still count. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Feed.

patches.name: Start on x86 devices
patches.description: Stops Instagram from crashing or freezing on x86 devices that run its code through a translator, such as some Chromebooks and emulators. Phones and tablets with arm chips run it as before. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Start stories with sound
patches.description: Opens stories with their sound on, the same as tapping Instagram's speaker. Your phone's ringer and volume still count. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Stories.

patches.name: Stop Reels scrolling
patches.description: Stops a swipe in Reels from moving to the next reel, so you stay on the one you opened. A second switch lets you watch 20 reels, then stops swiping for 15 minutes. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Reels.

patches.name: Stop Story auto-advance
patches.description: Keeps each story on screen until you tap or swipe. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Stories.

patches.name: Stop background wake-ups
patches.description: Stops two alarms that wake your phone while Instagram is in the background. One goes off every minute or two only to note that Instagram is still running, and the other wakes it five minutes later to upload usage events. Messages and notifications still arrive. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Battery.

patches.name: Stop swipe to create
patches.description: Stops a sideways swipe on Home from opening the camera. The + button still opens it. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Feed.

patches.name: Stop swipe up to reply
patches.description: Stops a swipe up on someone's story from opening the reply box and its reactions. Tapping Send message still replies. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Stories.

patches.name: Stop swiping between tabs
patches.description: Stops a sideways swipe from moving between Home, Reels and the other main tabs. Tapping the tab bar still works. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Feed.

patches.name: Story ring size
patches.description: Draws the rings in the stories row at the top of Home smaller, so more fit on screen, or larger, and the ring of a story you haven't watched in a color you pick. Nothing changes until you pick a size or a color. On by default. Turn it off in TADa settings > Stories.

patches.name: Swipe controls
patches.description: Adds options to enable and configure volume and brightness swipe controls.

patches.name: Swipe left to open the profile
patches.description: Makes a left swipe on a reel open the profile of the person who posted it, like Instagram used to. Tap Friends at the top to reach your friends' reels. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Reels.

patches.name: TADa launch screen
patches.description: Shows TADa's logo instead of Instagram's on the screen you see while Instagram starts, on Android 13 and newer. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Layout.

patches.name: TADa settings
patches.description: Adds a TADa settings page to Instagram. Open it by long-pressing the Instagram logo at the top of your feed or Instagram's icon, or from the top of Settings and activity. Turn features on or off there, pause TADa and save diagnostics. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Tap a feed video to pause it
patches.description: A tap on the video playing in a feed pauses it in place instead of opening it in Reels, and another tap plays it again. Ads keep Instagram's own tap. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Feed.

patches.name: Tap to play
patches.description: Makes videos, reels and stories wait for your tap instead of starting by themselves, like Instagram does when it saves mobile data. A choice under the switch can leave Reels out or hold only Reels. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Playback.

patches.name: Theme
patches.description: Adds options for theming, and settings to change the app foreground and background colors.

options.title: Dark theme color
options.description: Can be a hex color (#RRGGBB) or a color resource reference. Setting a color of either theme applies both while patching and removes the in-app theme color settings.

patches.name: Theme
patches.description: Adds options for theming, and settings to change the app foreground and background colors.

options.title: Dark theme color
options.description: Can be a hex color (#RRGGBB) or a color resource reference. Setting a color of either theme applies both while patching and removes the in-app theme color settings.

options.title: Light theme color
options.description: Can be a hex color (#RRGGBB) or a color resource reference. Setting a color of either theme applies both while patching and removes the in-app theme color settings.

patches.name: Third-party lyrics
patches.description: Adds an option to show synced lyrics with experience enhancement from 16+ providers in the lyrics panel.

patches.name: Turn off HDR brightness boosts
patches.description: Stops HDR photos and reels from making the screen brighter than everything else. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Playback.

patches.name: Turn off double tap to like
patches.description: Stops a double tap on a post or reel from liking it, and the heart doesn't show. The Like button still works. Separate switches cover posts, reels, comments and chat messages. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Reels.

patches.name: Upload stories at full quality
patches.description: Sends the video stories you post at up to 1080 pixels wide instead of 720, as Instagram does with its own Upload at highest quality setting on. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Stories.

patches.name: Use the system photo picker
patches.description: Adds an entry to Instagram's gallery sheet that opens Android's own photo picker when you make a post, so you pick from your photos and any cloud gallery and Instagram only gets what you choose. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Ads and privacy.

patches.name: Video quality
patches.description: Adds options to set default video qualities and always use the advanced video quality menu.

patches.name: View DM photos and videos anonymously
patches.description: Holds back the Opened notice for view once photos and videos in messages, so the sender doesn't see you opened them. Ghost mode turns it on too. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Ads and privacy.

patches.name: View live anonymously
patches.description: Keeps you off the viewer list of the lives you watch, so the host isn't told you're there. Your own lives still count their viewers. Ghost mode turns it on too. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Stories.

patches.name: View stories anonymously
patches.description: Keeps you off the viewer list of the stories you watch. Replying or reacting still shows you. An optional Mark as seen button lets you choose. Ghost mode turns it on too. Starts off. Turn it on in TADa settings > Stories.

patches.name: Voice over translation
patches.description: Adds additional voice over languages using text-to-speech synchronized to the video playback.

patches.name: Wide search bar
patches.description: Adds a wide search bar to the top of the home and subscription feed.
